description: “This is a lot money in our sixth disaster relief bill since 2016,” said state House Majority Leader John Bell (R-Wayne). “Thank goodness we are a state that is fiscally responsible, that is prepared for disasters, to provide relief to victims who desperately need our help in recovery. Where schools were devastated, where infrastructure was devastated, we’re helping them rebuild, and we’re doing it in the right way that is sustainable over the long-term.”
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY ELECT JOHN BELL COMMITTTEE
title: More Hurricane Relief Approved by NC House
